mapper.update: UPDATE its_application_data AS h SET data_ready_flag = (v.cmdb_id IS NOT NULL) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT cmdb_id FROM its_application_access_data WHERE (bpo IS NOT NULL AND bpo != '') OR (app_bpo IS NOT NULL AND app_bpo != '') ) AS v WHERE h.cmdb_id = v.cmdb_id AND h.data_ready_flag = false;
mapper.select:
SELECT ipd.* from its_application_data ipd where 1=1
AND ipd.uar_processor ~* '\y(${bean.itCodeOfUser})\y'

SELECT ipd.* from its_application_data ipd where 1=1
AND (ipd.operation_owner ~* '\y(${bean.itCodeOfUser})\y' OR ipd.operation_focal ~* '\y(${bean.itCodeOfUser})\y' OR ipd.application_it_owner ~* '\y(${bean.itCodeOfUser})\y')
SELECT DISTINCT ${col} AS label, ${col} AS value FROM its_application_data WHERE delete_flag = false AND ${col} IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ${col} DESC

SELECT distinct t.${fieldName} "label", t.${fieldName} "value" FROM its_application_data t
t.${fieldName} IS NOT NULL AND t.${fieldName} !=''
AND t.cmdb_id in ( select distinct cmdb_id from its_application_data where online_time is not null )
AND t.cmdb_id in (
#{item}
)
AND t.cmdb_id in (${scopeSql})
order by "label"
